def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    shares = 200_000
    price_per_share_eur = 90
    euro_amount = shares * price_per_share_eur

    initiation_spot_ask = 1.3983
    initiation_forward_point_ask = -0.0183
    three_month_forward_ask = 1.4210
    three_month_forward_point_ask = -0.0210
    usd_libor = 0.01266
    days_remaining = 90

    original_forward_rate = initiation_spot_ask + initiation_forward_point_ask
    current_forward_rate = three_month_forward_ask + three_month_forward_point_ask

    # Calculate the USD settlement cost, discounted for the remaining three months
    undiscounted_cost = (current_forward_rate - original_forward_rate) * euro_amount
    discount_factor = 1 + usd_libor * (days_remaining / 360)
    cash_expenditure = undiscounted_cost / discount_factor

    # Return the answer rounded to one decimal place
    return round(cash_expenditure, 1)
